headline: Ye cut off “Praise God” mid-set and said his iconic “Play Off The Grid” line 😂😂🔥 “Hold
body:
Ye cut off “Praise God” mid-set and said his iconic “Play Off The Grid” line 😂😂🔥
“Hold on, hold on, play ‘Off The Grid.’”

Same request he’s been making at listening parties for years. Crowd already knew what was coming. He stopped the record and ran it.

“Off The Grid” dropped on Donda in 2021 with Playboi Carti and Fivio Foreign. Peaked at #11 on the Hot 100, #4 on R&B/Hip-Hop, #7 on the Billboard Global 200. Platinum in the U.S. Still one of the hardest live records from that album.

Who got to see Ye in Chicago??
